n2e938ea397.headline: MERA Reduces Petrol Price by K463 per Litre
n2e938ea397.summary: The Malawi Energy Regulatory Authority announced a K463 per litre cut in petrol prices, bringing the new pump price down from K6,672.
n2e938ea397.why: Fuel prices feed into transport and inflation costs across the economy, and regulated pump prices reflect import costs and forex availability.

ne1cf529aa5.headline: British Airways’ parent company expects £1.7bn hit from higher fuel bill
ne1cf529aa5.summary: International Airlines Group, the parent of British Airways, expects a £1.7 billion hit from higher fuel prices, with chief executive Luis Gallego saying it is managing the uncertainty.
ne1cf529aa5.why: IAG owns British Airways, Iberia and other airlines, and fuel is one of their largest operating costs.

n6ea5f6c8e7.headline: The U.S. fires on Iranian tankers trying to evade its blockade amid a Hormuz standoff
n6ea5f6c8e7.summary: U.S. forces fired on two Iranian oil tankers after exchanging fire with Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz. The UAE reported another Iranian missile and drone attack.
n6ea5f6c8e7.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint for global seaborne oil shipments, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices and energy-sector equities.
n6ea5f6c8e7.why_moved: Exchanges of fire in the Strait of Hormuz and a reported attack on the UAE raise fears of disruption to Gulf oil flows, which tends to lift crude prices.

n01aebce36c.headline: SVG and the IMF Report - Searchlight
n01aebce36c.summary: A press conference by the prime minister and the IMF staff team head followed the Article IV Consultation visit from April 21 to 28. Debate has since been largely political.
n01aebce36c.why: IMF Article IV consultations assess a member country's economic policies and fiscal sustainability, informing investor views on its credit risk.

ndf9facb11b.headline: Lusca cleared to acquire Morton plant on Inagua
ndf9facb11b.summary: Lusca Group's subsidiary Grand Bahama Salt Company has secured all final regulatory approvals for the acquisition of Morton Bahamas. The deal concerns a plant on Inagua.
ndf9facb11b.why: Lusca Group is an industrial investment and energy trading company, and this acquisition expands its salt production footprint in the Bahamas.

n3aa08bba71.headline: Inside the Middle Corridor push: Georgia and Turkmenistan shift into execution mode
n3aa08bba71.summary: Georgia's Economy Minister Mariam Kvrivishvili visited Ashgabat for the 5th session of the Intergovernmental Georgian-Turkmen Commission. The Middle Corridor transport route was the focus.
n3aa08bba71.why: The Middle Corridor is an overland trade route linking Central Asia with the Caucasus and Europe, which matters for freight and regional trade flows.

n1401538255.headline: Smart Line plant at VinIndustry Industrial Park launches production of paint booths for metalworking industry
n1401538255.summary: The Smart Line plant at the VinIndustry Industrial Park in Vinnytsia has started producing paint booths for the metalworking industry, with first-phase investment of UAH 46 million.
n1401538255.why: Industrial investment in manufacturing capacity indicates activity in Ukraine's industrial sector despite wartime conditions.

n2c4568e4a1.headline: The U.S. fires on Iranian tankers trying to evade its blockade amid a Hormuz standoff
n2c4568e4a1.summary: US forces fired on two Iranian oil tankers after exchanging fire with Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz. The UAE reported another Iranian missile and drone attack.
n2c4568e4a1.why: Iranian crude exports and Gulf shipping routes are central to global oil supply, so naval confrontations in Hormuz feed directly into energy markets.
n2c4568e4a1.why_moved: Fire exchanges and attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz raise the risk of disrupted Gulf crude flows, which pressures oil prices.

n292df2a939.headline: Tehran could withstand blockade for four months, CIA report shows, as fighting flares
n292df2a939.summary: A CIA report indicates Tehran could withstand a blockade for about four months, while US leverage over Tehran remains limited as the two sides seek to end the conflict.
n292df2a939.why: Blockade endurance determines how long Iranian oil exports and the broader economy can be squeezed, a key variable for global energy supply.

nfcc2219851.headline: Tool for appealing refusals to grant urban planning conditions, restrictions to become operational in summer – architecture inspectorate head
nfcc2219851.summary: A package of government decisions to simplify construction regulation will become operational in the summer, the head of Ukraine's architecture inspectorate said.
nfcc2219851.why: Construction rules and permitting speed affect developer costs and the pace of housing and infrastructure investment.

na579306961.headline: Trump insists truce still holds after US-Iran flare-up
na579306961.summary: President Donald Trump has played down an exchange of fire between Iran and the US, while Tehran accuses the US of violating the truce.
na579306961.why: Whether the US-Iran truce holds determines the risk of renewed disruption to Gulf energy flows.

nb63099f78a.headline: EU's Ukraine Support Loan to reduce 2026 budget deficit from 18.5% to 12.1% of GDP – Finance Ministry
nb63099f78a.summary: Taking half of the EU's EUR 90 billion Ukraine Support Loan into account, Ukraine's 2026 budget deficit would fall from 18.5% to 12.1% of GDP, the Finance Ministry said.
nb63099f78a.why: The EU Ukraine Support Loan is a major external financing source that helps cover Ukraine's wartime budget gap.

n1fa67a2770.headline: EBRD, PrivatBank launch partial debt write-off mechanism for war-affected businesses
n1fa67a2770.summary: The EBRD and PrivatBank are launching a EUR 6.8 million pilot to partially write off debt of Ukrainian businesses whose financed assets are damaged by hostilities.
n1fa67a2770.why: The EBRD is a multilateral development lender, and PrivatBank is Ukraine's largest bank, so the scheme affects credit risk in a war-hit economy.

naf481da65e.headline: 'Spendthrift' sandgropers trigger GST allowance critics
naf481da65e.summary: Economists have criticised the scale of cash handouts in the Western Australian budget, arguing they are excessive. The criticism centres on the GST allowance.
naf481da65e.why: State budgets set spending and revenue for public services and shape regional demand, and they influence state credit ratings and bond issuance.

n31b14cf631.headline: Ukrainian govt proposes increasing 2026 state budget revenues by over UAH 2.2 trln – PM
n31b14cf631.summary: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers proposes the Verkhovna Rada raise 2026 state budget revenues by more than UAH 2.2 trillion. The proposal was announced by Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko.
n31b14cf631.why: Budget revenue targets determine government financing needs and borrowing, which matter for Ukraine's sovereign debt and currency outlook.

nc2f874b912.headline: S&P 500 and Nasdaq notch records, boosted by AI and earnings optimism
nc2f874b912.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq posted record levels, boosted by artificial intelligence and earnings optimism. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.02 per cent to 49,609.16 points.
nc2f874b912.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark index of large US companies, and the Nasdaq Composite is weighted toward technology stocks. Their levels are widely used as gauges of US equity market sentiment.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index itself reached a record high, as stated in the headline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

impacts.name: Dow Jones Industrial Average
impacts.why: The Dow rose slightly, to 49,609.16 points.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nc2f874b912.why_moved: Investor optimism about artificial intelligence and corporate earnings lifted US equity indexes to record levels.

n8fe80cc796.headline: Hatzidakis Unveils New Reform Agenda
n8fe80cc796.summary: Vietnam and India exchanged 13 cooperation agreements between ministries, agencies and institutions during To Lam's state visit to India. The agreements were witnessed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
n8fe80cc796.why: Bilateral agreements between governments can open trade, investment and industrial cooperation between Southeast Asia and South Asia.

ncfdbb2ad21.headline: The prospect of peace remains murky
ncfdbb2ad21.summary: Several pauses toward a potential peace agreement between the United States and Iran have occurred, but intermittent flare-ups continue across the region and clear certainty remains elusive.
ncfdbb2ad21.why: US-Iran tensions affect Middle East oil supply and risk premiums that feed into global energy prices.

n492ff7735e.headline: SCG profit holds steady as group navigates energy cost pressures
n492ff7735e.summary: SCG reported a rise in first-quarter adjusted cash earnings despite global volatility and rising energy costs, according to Vietnam Investment Review.
n492ff7735e.why: SCG is a Thai industrial conglomerate with cement, chemicals and packaging businesses, so energy costs directly affect its margins.

n586c888463.headline: Gold Price Nears $4,750 on Iran Peace Hopes — Analyst Predicts 'Strongest Bull Market in History'
n586c888463.summary: Gold prices approached $4,750 an ounce on hopes of a US-Iran peace deal. An analyst cited central bank buying, currency debasement and rising US debt as supporting factors.
n586c888463.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that investors and central banks hold as a hedge against geopolitical stress, inflation and currency weakness.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold is the asset whose price is discussed in relation to peace-deal expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n586c888463.why_moved: Expectations of a US-Iran peace deal are reducing geopolitical risk premia, while the analyst cites structural drivers such as central bank buying and debt concerns.

nf727bccd33.headline: British Airways issues summer flights update amid disruptions from fuel prices
nf727bccd33.summary: International Airlines Group, the parent of British Airways, issued an update on summer flights amid disruptions caused by the Middle East conflict and fuel prices. The update covers the airline group's operations.
nf727bccd33.why: IAG is a major European airline group, and fuel costs are one of its largest operating expenses.

n2c3ea2500b.headline: Citi Investor Day outlines clear path for next growth phase
n2c3ea2500b.summary: Citi laid out a clear path for its next phase of growth, pointing to stronger returns, disciplined execution, client-led growth and the strength of its global network.
n2c3ea2500b.why: Citigroup is a major global bank, and its investor day targets guide investor expectations for returns and growth.

n2b279a9484.headline: HDB likely to exceed initial 55,000-flat target from 2025 to 2027: Chee Hong Tat
n2b279a9484.summary: Singapore's Housing and Development Board is likely to exceed its 55,000-flat target for 2025 to 2027 due to strong demand, according to Minister Chee Hong Tat.
n2b279a9484.why: The Housing and Development Board is Singapore's public housing agency, and its build programme shapes local construction activity and housing supply.

n7dacefc75b.headline: U.S.-Iran peace talks face fresh hurdles amid blockade escalation
n7dacefc75b.summary: US forces struck and disabled two empty Iranian-flagged oil tankers trying to breach a naval blockade on Friday. Washington is awaiting a formal Tehran response to a proposed deal.
n7dacefc75b.why: Iranian crude exports are a significant share of global oil supply, so naval blockades and sanctions on Iran directly affect crude prices and shipping risk.
n7dacefc75b.why_moved: A US blockade of Iranian oil tankers and a stalled peace process raise uncertainty over Iranian crude supply.

n9ab347cbd8.headline: Stocks mixed, dollar down as investors digest US job growth, chipmaker strength and elevated oil
n9ab347cbd8.summary: Global equities were mixed while the dollar weakened after new US data showed domestic job growth. Elevated oil prices were also in focus for investors.
n9ab347cbd8.why: The US dollar and US labour data shape expectations for Federal Reserve policy, which affects global equities and currencies.
n9ab347cbd8.why_moved: Reported US job growth and elevated oil prices were the main inputs for investors, and the dollar weakened on the data.

nf5fcd1732c.headline: Stocks surge to end the week, driven by Tech, as Iran response is awaited - Newsquawk US Market Wrap
nf5fcd1732c.summary: US stocks rose to end the week, driven by technology, as the Iran response was awaited. Nonfarm payrolls beat expectations with the unemployment rate unchanged, while US military strikes in Iran were reported.
nf5fcd1732c.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq track large US companies, and their moves reflect jobs data, geopolitical risk and tech sector sentiment.
nf5fcd1732c.why_moved: A stronger-than-expected payrolls report and a tech-led rally pushed US stocks higher, despite geopolitical uncertainty over Iran.

n3a4ea3cb9c.headline: FlySafair extends ticket surcharge to August
n3a4ea3cb9c.summary: FlySafair has extended its ticket surcharge to August and said it could last longer if strong Eurozone summer demand keeps pressure on jet fuel prices.
n3a4ea3cb9c.why: Airlines' operating costs are highly sensitive to jet fuel prices, which are set by crude oil and refining margins. Surcharges pass these costs on to passengers.

nc05281564d.headline: Emirates Lifts Airbus A380 Bonus to 20 Weeks After Dh19.7 Billion Profit
nc05281564d.summary: Emirates posted a Dh19.7 billion profit after tax for the fiscal year ended March 2026, with revenue up 2 per cent to Dh130.9 billion. Eligible staff will receive a 20-week bonus.
nc05281564d.why: Emirates is the Dubai-based flagship carrier of Dubai's state-owned Emirates Group. Its results signal demand strength in long-haul air travel.

na532ecf85c.headline: Trump insists truce still holds after US-Iran flare-up
na532ecf85c.summary: President Donald Trump played down an exchange of fire between Iran and the US and said the truce still holds, while Tehran accused the US of violations.
na532ecf85c.why: The US-Iran truce bears on Middle East security, oil supply risk and the pace of sanctions and shipping normalization.

n1ca97800cc.headline: Dabur shares jump 4% after Q4 results. What are Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Nomura saying?
n1ca97800cc.summary: Dabur India shares climbed 4% after the company reported a 15% rise in net profit for the March quarter. Revenue also increased healthily.
n1ca97800cc.why: Dabur is a large Indian consumer goods company, and its quarterly results signal demand trends for branded FMCG products in India.

n62f1a1f762.headline: Air India delays staff salary hikes over rising fuel prices, airspace curbs
n62f1a1f762.summary: Air India has deferred annual employee increments by at least one quarter as it steps up cost-cutting amid rising fuel prices and airspace curbs.
n62f1a1f762.why: Air India is a Tata Group-owned airline, and fuel is one of the largest operating costs for carriers.
